description: Defines the DirectoryReader class for enumerating directory entries on Linux without using standard directory functions.

classes.name: DirectoryReader
classes.description: A class for enumerating directory entries without using diropen/readdir, utilizing Linux sys_getdents system call.

methods.name: GetNextEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the next directory entry, returning true if successful, false on EOF or error.

methods.name: PopEntry
methods.description: Advances the directory reading cursor by removing the current entry from the buffer.
